name: labs/silab-bonn__basil
title: ISEG SHQ/NQH series high-voltage supply
intro: ISEG SHQ/NQH series high-voltage supply, adapted from silab-bonn/basil. It reads `voltage` and `current`; sets `voltage_target`, `ramp_speed`, `answer_delay`, `autostart` and 1 more; runs `output_off`. `output_off`: set the channel's target voltage to 0 V (the upstream off()), the safe state of the supply. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/silab-bonn__basil --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/silab-bonn__basil --backend fake --mcp
